entities.name: 5GMM sublayer
entities.description: The 5GS mobility management sublayer supports UE identification, security, mobility, and generic message transport. It also provides connection management services to other sublayers.

entities.name: UE identification
entities.description: Function provided by the 5GMM sublayer to identify the UE.

entities.name: Security
entities.description: Function provided by the 5GMM sublayer to ensure security.

entities.name: Mobility
entities.description: Function provided by the 5GMM sublayer to support UE mobility.

entities.name: Generic message transport
entities.description: Function provided by the 5GMM sublayer for transporting generic messages.

entities.name: Connection management services
entities.description: Services provided by the 5GMM sublayer to other sublayers for connection management.

entities.name: Satellite NG-RAN access
entities.description: Condition where GNSS fix time in lower layers can delay initial UL NAS message transmission by up to 100 seconds in GNSS cold state.

relations.description: The 5GMM sublayer establishes UE identification functionality.
The 5GMM sublayer establishes generic message transport functionality.
The 5GMM sublayer establishes connection management services for other sublayers.
Satellite NG-RAN access condition guards generic message transport by potentially delaying initial UL NAS message transmission.
